class.name: GoapAgent
class.brief_description: Runs goal oriented action planning for one character.

method.name: abort_plan
method.description: Stops the running action, calling its [method GoapAction._exit] with [code]false[/code], and drops the plan. The agent plans again on its next step, subject to [member replan_delay]. [param reason] is passed straight through to [signal plan_aborted], so a caller can tell listeners why it intervened.

method.name: erase_state
method.description: Removes the fact [param key] from [member world_state]. Shorthand for [method GoapContext.erase_state] on [member context].

method.name: get_current_action
method.description: Returns the action being executed, or [code]null[/code] if there is no plan.

method.name: get_current_goal
method.description: Returns the goal the current plan is working towards, or [code]null[/code] if there is no plan.

method.name: get_plan
method.description: Returns the plan being executed, or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_last_plan_result
method.description: Returns why the last planning attempt ended the way it did. See [method GoapPlanner.get_last_result].

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the value of the fact [param key] in [member world_state], or [param default] if it is not set. Shorthand for [method GoapContext.get_state] on [member context].

method.name: has_state
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the fact [param key] is present in [member world_state]. Shorthand for [method GoapContext.has_state] on [member context].

method.name: is_idle
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the agent has no plan because there was nothing worth doing, as opposed to having failed to find one. An agent whose goals are all satisfied is idle; one whose goals are out of reach is not. Use this to tell the two cases apart instead of treating every [signal planning_failed] as a problem.

method.name: request_plan
method.description: Drops the running plan and plans again immediately, ignoring [member replan_delay] and [member async_planning]. Returns [code]true[/code] if a plan was found. The search always runs to completion here, because the caller is asking for an answer right now.

method.name: set_state
method.description: Sets the fact [param key] in [member world_state] to [param value]. Shorthand for [method GoapContext.set_state] on [member context]. This does not interrupt the running plan; follow it with [method request_plan] when it should.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns a list of authoring mistakes found in this agent's actions and goals: facts a goal asks for that no action produces, preconditions nothing can establish, and comparison strings that do not parse. These are the failures that otherwise show up only as a planner that silently never finds a plan. [codeblock] # "have_wood" when every action produces "has_wood" is caught here. for warning in $GoapAgent.validate(): push_warning(warning) [/codeblock] The same list drives the node's configuration warnings in the editor. Actions and goals that build their preconditions, effects or desired state from script are skipped, since there is nothing static to check.

method.name: update
method.description: Advances the agent by one step: plans if needed, then ticks the current action. Called automatically unless [member process_callback] is [constant PROCESS_CALLBACK_MANUAL].

members.member: Everything this agent knows how to do. Assigning a new array drops the running plan. Actions the agent cannot currently perform are better left in place and rejected through [method GoapAction._is_valid] than added and removed at runtime.

If [code]true[/code], the search is spread over several frames at [member planning_budget] nodes each instead of blocking on it. Worth enabling once a scene holds enough agents that a single frame's planning shows up in a profile. The search still runs on the main thread, so actions and goals keep their usual access to the scene tree. Agents using this must each own their [member planner], since it holds the in-flight search.
If [code]false[/code], the agent stops planning and executing, and drops any running plan. Use it to hand control to a cutscene or another behavior.
The [GoapContext] passed to every action and goal. The agent creates one on its own; assign a different one to share state between agents or to prepare a world state before the agent starts.

Everything this agent wants. Assigning a new array drops the running plan. Ordering them is not required, [member GoapGoal.priority] decides, but a low priority fallback goal that is always reachable keeps the agent from idling.

The planner used to build plans. The agent creates one on its own; assign a different one to tune its search limits or to share it between agents. Setting this to [code]null[/code] restores a default planner rather than leaving the agent without one.
How many search nodes a single frame may expand while [member async_planning] is on. Lower values spread the cost further at the price of taking longer to reach a plan.
When the agent steps itself. Use [constant PROCESS_CALLBACK_MANUAL] and call [method update] yourself to run several agents on a rotation instead of all of them every frame.

The minimum time in seconds between two planning attempts. It keeps an agent whose goals are all unreachable from re-running the search every frame; the first attempt is never delayed, and [method request_plan] ignores this entirely.
The symbolic facts the agent plans over. Shorthand for [member GoapContext.world_state] on [member context].

signal.name: action_finished
signal.description: Emitted after an action's [method GoapAction._exit] runs, whether it succeeded, failed, or was interrupted. [param result] is an [enum ActionResult]. It separates an action that reported [constant GoapAction.STATUS_FAILED] from one that was cut short by a replan, which [param succeeded] alone cannot express.

signal.name: action_started
signal.description: Emitted after an action's [method GoapAction._enter] runs.

signal.name: plan_aborted
signal.description: Emitted when a plan is dropped before finishing. [param reason] is an [enum AbortReason]: it says whether an action failed, the world moved on, or something asked for a replan.

signal.name: plan_completed
signal.description: Emitted when every action of a plan has succeeded.

signal.name: plan_found
signal.description: Emitted when planning succeeds, before the first action starts.

signal.name: planning_failed
signal.description: Emitted when no plan was produced. [param result] is a [enum GoapPlanner.PlanResult] saying why, which matters because this also fires — every [member replan_delay], indefinitely — for an agent whose goals are simply all satisfied. Compare against [constant GoapPlanner.PLAN_RESULT_IDLE], or call [method is_idle], before treating it as a problem.

constants.constant: Step the agent every rendered frame, in [constant Node.NOTIFICATION_PROCESS].
Step the agent every physics frame, in [constant Node.NOTIFICATION_PHYSICS_PROCESS]. Use this when actions move a physics body.
Do not step the agent automatically; call [method update] instead.
[method abort_plan] or [method request_plan] was called, or [member actions] or [member goals] was reassigned.
[method GoapAction._is_valid] turned [code]false[/code] before the next action could start.
The next action's preconditions no longer hold; the world moved on since the plan was built. The action never started, so no [signal action_finished] accompanies this.
The action was cut short because the plan was dropped out from under it.
